mcat_description.short: Greenhouse Construction Services covers end-to-end design, fabrication, and installation of agricultural greenhouse and polyhouse structures — including naturally ventilated polyhouses, fan-and-pad climate-controlled greenhouses, shade net houses, and polycarbonate greenhouses — delivered as turnkey projects for farmers and agri-entrepreneurs across India.
mcat_description.long: In the Indian market, greenhouse construction services are primarily delivered as turnkey projects encompassing site assessment, structural design, GI/MS pipe framework fabrication, covering installation (UV-stabilized polyethylene film, shade net, or polycarbonate panels), and integration of drip irrigation, fogging, and ventilation systems. The dominant structure type is the Naturally Ventilated Polyhouse (NVPH), which uses passive airflow and is the most cost-effective and widely subsidy-eligible option under NHB and NHM schemes. Higher-end Fan and Pad climate-controlled greenhouses serve commercial floriculture and exotic vegetable growers requiring precise temperature and humidity regulation. Buyers typically seek NHB/NHM subsidy-compliant construction, with service providers often assisting in DPR preparation and subsidy documentation alongside physical construction.

market_context: In India, 'Greenhouse Construction Services' is commercially synonymous with polyhouse construction — a turnkey agricultural service delivering GI-pipe-framed, UV-stabilized polyfilm or shade-net-covered structures for protected cultivation. The Naturally Ventilated Polyhouse (NVPH) is the dominant structure type by volume, favoured for its lower cost and eligibility under NHB and NHM government subsidy schemes that provide up to 50% of project cost (with state top-ups reaching 65–95% in some states). The Fan and Pad climate-controlled greenhouse is the premium segment, used for high-value floriculture and exotic vegetables requiring precise temperature and humidity control. Shade net houses represent the most economical entry point, with NHB cost norms lower than polyhouses. Service providers typically offer end-to-end turnkey delivery: site survey, structural design, GI pipe framework (B-Class, 2mm thickness per NHB standards), covering installation, drip/fogging irrigation integration, and subsidy documentation support. Key buyer decision drivers include NHB/NHM subsidy compliance, structure type, covered area (sq mt), frame material quality, ventilation system, and crop suitability. The market spans individual farmers (500–4,000 sq mt under NHM) to large commercial farms (4,000–16,000 sq mt under NHB), agricultural universities, state horticulture departments, and corporate agribusinesses. Construction is typically completed within 45–60 days after NHB Letter of Intent (LOI) approval.
